description: NaBaBO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.42 Å) and four longer (2.52 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.39 Å) and two longer (2.60 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.05 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.40 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, three equivalent Ba, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, three equivalent Ba, and one B atom.
